650: A mysterious Mutant Digimon that seems to come from a parallel dimension. It can travel between worlds and appears out of nowhere. With its special move “Absorbent Bang” it simply soaks up enemy attacks and hurls their power back; with “Endless Trance” it puts its foes into an endless dream they never wake up from.
655: A Mutant Digimon whose body is constantly changing. It can copy the shape and abilities of other Digimon, which is why nobody knows its true form. With “Transceirave” it turns into its opponent, and with “Laser Translation” it translates the opponent's data into a destructive beam of light.
1033: A form of Greymon driven by pure rage. It has lost control of its enormous power and rampages aimlessly through the Digital World – not even its allies are safe from it. Its special move “Giga Tempest” unleashes a storm of fire that lays waste to whole regions.
1043: A giant Monzaemon filled with malice. From the outside it looks like a friendly teddy bear, but inside, everything good has turned into hatred. With “Heartbreak Attack” it fires black hearts that rob everyone of their courage, and with “Giga Heartbreak Attack” it rains a whole hail of them down on its enemies.
401: A mysterious baby Digimon that feeds on the data of other Digimon. Even though it is still tiny, it uses “Data Drain” to absorb any data that gets too close, and grows from it. Nobody knows who created it – people only say it becomes more dangerous with every stage.
407: An Arkadimon that has grown to the Champion stage by devouring countless pieces of data. It has taken the shape of an eerie beast and hunts for new prey in the Dark Area. With “Prison Fist” it holds its prey tight, and with “Snatch Whip” it rips the data right out of it.
416: An Ultimate-level Arkadimon that already carries the data of many strong Digimon inside it. Its body changes with every meal, and its hunger for data keeps growing. With “Dot Matrix” it breaks opponents down into single data points, and with “Freeze Tentacles” it catches them with ice-cold tentacles.
427: The final form of Arkadimon, born from the data of countless Digimon. It is said to be one of the most dangerous Digimon of all, because it can turn anything it touches into its own data. With “Dot Matrix” it erases opponents pixel by pixel, and with “Exile Spear” it banishes them from the Digital World.
609: A Machine Digimon made of solid tin that looks like a giant toy robot. It is immune to every kind of spell: with “Anti-Magic” it simply cancels out magic attacks. That's why it is often sent against Digimon that fight with magic.
807: A Golem Digimon made of solid rock, brought to life by an unknown program. It moves slowly but is almost indestructible, and it loyally guards whatever it has been entrusted with. With “Guardian Bomb” it defends its territory, with “Anti-Digi Beam” it weakens opponents, and with “Gargant Press” it buries them under its enormous weight.
